page.heading: Skills

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Import a skill from a file, a URL, or the community catalog.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

page.subtitle: Reusable review guidance. A skill lives here once and any number of agents can link it.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
preview.importedNotice: This skill was imported. Its body is used as instructions, so read it before enabling it for an agent.

delete.confirmLinked: Delete "{name}"? It is linked by {agents}, which will lose it.

editor.subtitle: Guidance appended to the prompt of every agent that links it.
editor.nameHint: Short and stable — agents reference it by name.
editor.descriptionHint: This is the skill's interface, and it goes into the prompt above the body — write it as a directive ("Apply when…", "Report…"), because it is what the model uses to decide whether this skill applies to the diff in front of it.
editor.typeHint: Groups the library; it does not change how the body is used.
editor.bodyHint: Markdown. Goes into the prompt verbatim.
editor.bodyHintVersioned: Markdown. Saving a changed body mints a new immutable version.
editor.bodyPlaceholder:
# Rule

What a reviewer should flag, and what to cite.
editor.contextHint: Documents from this repository that every agent using this skill will inject. They are fenced as untrusted data — unlike the skill body above, which enters the prompt as instructions.
editor.contextAfterSave: Save the skill first — documents are attached to a saved skill.

import.title: Import a skill
import.subtitle: Read a .md or .zip skill, review it, then save it like any other.
import.pickerHint: A single .md file, or a .zip containing one.
import.ignoredNote: Only the skill markdown is imported; everything else in the archive is dropped here in the browser.
import.executableCount: {count, plural, one {# executable file} other {# executable files}} dropped
import.trustNotice: This text becomes instructions for a review agent. Read it before you save.
import.footerNote: Nothing is saved until you confirm in the editor.

context.overBudget: — over the run budget; the run will drop the overflow.
context.emptyBody: This repository has no Markdown under specs/, docs/ or insights/ — or it is still cloning. Open the Project Context page to see what DevDigest found.
context.hint: Documents attached to this skill are inherited by every agent that uses it, after the agent's own attachments.
